source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 3, 27. 29. 30. Ταπεινώσει γὰρ ἑαυτὸν φάσκων· «ἐγὼ δέ εἰμι γῆ καὶ σποδός«, εἴπερ ὄντως ἐστὶν ἀνήρ, καὶ τῆς μὴ καταισχυνούσης ἐλπίδος πεπλήρωται, ὁποῖον καὶ τὸ «ἐκολλήθη τῷ ἐδάφει ἡ φυχή μου.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] For he will humble himself saying: “I am earth and ash,” if indeed he truly is a man, and he has been filled with the hope that does not shame—such as also “my soul was stuck to the floor.”
pass_b_english: For he will humble himself saying: “I am earth and ash,” if indeed he truly is a man, and he has been filled with the hope that does not shame—such as also “my soul was stuck to the floor.”

choices.why: Origen’s reading of nephroi/arrows in Lam 3:13.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.
